He first performed for The New Shakespeare Company at Open Air Theatre, Regent's Park for two seasons.  He later portrayed George Tesman in Richard Eyre's revival of "Hedda Gabler" in 2005 and since then has starred in the Royal National Theatre productions "After the Dance" (2010) and "Frankenstein" (2011).  In 2015, he played William Shakespeare's "Hamlet" at the Barbican Theatre.
Rolandos Liatsos | Rolandos Liatsos (born May 30, 1990, Cyprus) is a Cypriot stage actor. In that play, he is the Master of Revels at Theseus' court, meaning he is in charge of his lord's entertainments, making recommendations to Theseus, as well as altering the text of some of the plays performed in his court.  Shakespeare may have used this character to poke fun at play censorship in London at the time.  In early performances of the play, the actor who played this character probably also played the part of Egeus, Hermia's strict father.
